burnout-aislamiento.summary: Little inclination to socialize, little available energy, distrust toward colleagues and a tendency toward sadness. At work, this combination is associated with a notably higher likelihood of severe physical and emotional exhaustion.

compromiso-y-estatus-social.effect: High occupational commitment and social status
compromiso-y-estatus-social.summary: Predicts pride in one's professional activity and commitment to work. Interpersonally, high social status, popularity and ease at taking on leadership roles.

ciudadania-organizacional.summary: Going beyond strict obligations: helping colleagues, contributing ideas for improvement, sustaining team morale and speaking well of the organization.

orientacion-prosocial.summary: An active interest in relating to others joined with genuine concern for their well-being. It is associated with helping behaviors, altruism, volunteering and satisfying family and couple relationships.

orientacion-al-poder.summary: Wanting to lead and prevail without empathy for other people's suffering and with no qualms about breaking courtesy. It is the combination that best predicts power-seeking behaviors and a readiness to use others as instruments.

proposito-y-autoaceptacion.effect: Sense of life purpose and self-acceptance
proposito-y-autoaceptacion.summary: Vitality and enthusiasm, the capacity to meet goals steadily and a mood far from dejection. It predicts clarity of direction in life and satisfaction with one's own worth.

crecimiento-personal.summary: Enthusiasm for exploring, a will to learn in depth and a desire to empathize with one's surroundings. These people feel they evolve and mature over time.

conexion-social.summary: Enthusiasm and social activity while keeping courtesy and respect for norms. It predicts more solid community, friendship and companionship bonds.

benevolencia.summary: Emotional empathy, belief in other people's goodness and an open mind. It predicts everyday prosocial behaviors: lending, supporting, caring for one's close circle.

proteccion-frente-al-conflicto.summary: Good beliefs about colleagues together with empathy work as a workplace protector: they raise satisfaction and reduce the wish to leave the work environment.

orientacion-a-la-seguridad.effect: Orientation toward safety and the predictable
orientacion-a-la-seguridad.summary: Values oriented toward avoiding risk, toward personal safety and keeping surroundings predictable. Profiles that move away from stimulation-seeking and from breaking routines.

salud-global.summary: The capacity to sustain orderly, healthy life habits while keeping emotional and interpersonal balance. The three facets together independently predict better perceived health.

rendimiento-global.summary: The whole Conscientiousness domain: designing orderly systems, having the persistence to execute them and a dutiful commitment toward the team.

dominio-del-entorno.summary: Being resolute and goal-focused while keeping one's mood far from dejection. It is among the strongest predictors of feeling competent to manage the demands of daily life.

hedonismo.summary: Little work discipline and a low sense of duty together with a desire to be with others. It favors putting leisure and short-term gratification ahead of long-term goals.

autonomia.summary: Meeting one's own duties, the mental flexibility to generate solutions and managing tension without anguish. It predicts independent decisions, little influenced by what others do or think.

busqueda-de-estimulacion.summary: Keeping one's word, high social energy and tolerance for disorder. It leads to actively seeking stimulating situations that break the routine.

resistencia-al-estres.summary: Managing tension without anguish and sustaining an even mood. It is the strongest predictor that colleagues and external evaluators will describe someone as stress-resistant.

falta-de-proposito.summary: Frequent sadness or insecurity, a lack of vitality and difficulty committing to one's own obligations. It is associated with the lowest levels of life meaning and clear goals.

relaciones-positivas.summary: An absence of dejection together with a desire to connect and empathic tenderness. It predicts satisfying interpersonal relationships and acceptance of one's own identity.

hostilidad-y-conflicto.effect: Risk of hostility and interpersonal conflict
hostilidad-y-conflicto.summary: Reacting with quick irritation on a base of little courtesy and little empathy. It is associated with dissatisfaction, confrontational behavior and severe conflict both in couples and at work.

burnout-irritabilidad.summary: An unstable mood joined with little interest in connecting with colleagues and, therefore, little social support available. It is one of the direct routes to severe professional burnout.

autodireccion.summary: A hunger for knowledge joined with the capacity to generate new visions. It defines exploratory profiles that investigate and act outside the norm out of intrinsic motivation.

universalismo.summary: Valuing beauty and one's surroundings together with a positive belief in others. It is associated with concern for the general well-being and with behaviors supporting collective and environmental causes.

apertura-plena.summary: The whole Open-Mindedness domain: a preference for a wide, complex range of perceptual, cognitive and affective experiences, actively seeking novelty.

conformidad-y-tradicion.summary: Little interest in generating new alternatives, rigid respect for norms and authority figures, and little pursuit of the social spotlight. It predicts conformist behavior and attachment to established rules.
